response.justification: The candidate substantially exceeds the 6+ years requirement with nearly two decades of full-stack experience, strong TypeScript/Node.js and React work at multiple companies, hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling experience, and a demonstrable testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, test frameworks he authored, CI/CD). Gaps are mostly at the framework level (no explicit Nest.js, Vitest, or Kotlin experience) rather than fundamental capability gaps, and his polyglot background suggests he can close them quickly.
strengths: Deep full-stack TypeScript/Node.js + React experience across several senior roles
Direct AI-agent development experience, including MCP code generators and agentic tooling
Strong testing and engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks, cloud/K8s/Docker experience)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest/Playwright experience mentioned
Kotlin and Python not listed; Java exposure appears dated and limited
Frequent role changes and heavy niche-language (DLang) focus may need probing for stack alignment

key_factors.factor: AI agent and MCP development experience
